candidates.name: Dermatomyositis
support_spans: Photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption
Diffuse erythema of forehead and midface, involving nasolabial folds
Prominent erythema at nailfolds with dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles
contradict_spans: Vastus lateralis muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers without evidence of inflammatory myositis
candidates.why: The patient's skin symptoms and muscle weakness are consistent with dermatomyositis.
